environment.description: Same Go WebSocket service on ECS Fargate with Aurora PostgreSQL. The database cluster has a custom parameter group with 'pgaudit.log=all' and uses a non-superuser role 'app_svc_ro'. Tables have ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied. The RLS policy is defined as: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON <table> USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid). Additionally, a pg_event_trigger fires on SET commands to validate that app.current_tenant matches the authenticated role's granted tenant from a role-to-tenant mapping table (pg_catalog extension). The connection pooler (PgBouncer in transaction mode) issues a RESET ALL between transactions, and the pool uses PREPARED statement caching disabled to prevent plan leakage.

config.rls_policies: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all tenant-scoped tables
config.event_trigger: validates SET app.current_tenant against pg_auth_members mapping
config.pgaudit: enabled, logs all DML with tenant context
config.network: Aurora in isolated subnet, security group allows only ECS task SG
